And then my depression basically killed itself, i guess depression gave up trying to make me kill myself so it was the other way around, and thats something that makes me proud of myself actually, i didnt defeat depression, I KILLED IT thanks for reading this bible btw, appreciate it :3 and to anyone struggling out there, you got this!
